Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent full-body 2D Japanese anime chibi BOSS sprite for the game Refrain.
Primary request: redesign the FIRST referenced Akari boss to be dramatically more elaborate and striking, equal to the other boss references, while retaining her recognizable identity and vulnerable personality.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target Akari idle boss (orange bob haircut, small side ponytail on image left, pale face, luminous ice-blue eyes, tired withdrawn expression, office woman hugging her smartphone while floating with her knees raised). Image 2 Koharu and image 3 Rei are STYLE and silhouette-complexity references ONLY; do not copy their identities or costume.
Outfit design: transform Akari's familiar cream cardigan, white work blouse, blue employee lanyard and charcoal work trousers into an ornate supernatural office-derived boss outfit. Ivory fitted cardigan/jacket with dark charcoal lining, sharp folded-envelope lapels, pale-gold ornamental edges, prominent amber bow/clip on the original side ponytail, visible blue employee ID on chest. Her cardigan extends into a spectacular asymmetric layered split-tail mantle, made of broad folded ivory paper-like fabric panels with dark charcoal reverse and thin luminous cyan stitched edges. Long amber-gold lanyard ribbons and pale cyan ribbon tails sweep around the lower silhouette like unwritten correspondence, clearly attached to costume, not disconnected effects. Keep the top of head recognizable, no crown. Both trousers and both dark pumps visible.
Pose: SAME floating seated curled-in pose with both knees held against her chest, smartphone held close. Keep entire body and all clothing in frame with a generous transparent margin. Two fully connected arms and hands, two fully connected legs and feet, clean correct anatomy. Full character head-to-shoes occupies about 85% of image height, outfit width about 75% of image height. Head is about 36% of body height, approximately 2.8 heads tall, matching references. Face three-quarter toward the RIGHT. Face remains numb and lonely, not smiling or angry.
Style: premium clean anime mobile-game chibi illustration, crisp fine colored outlines, rich but controlled cel shading and soft highlights, clearly defined folds, warm orange hair contrasted with ivory/charcoal clothes and icy cyan details. Same rendering quality as references, NOT realistic and NOT pixel art.
Background: genuinely transparent RGBA PNG, no checkerboard drawn into pixels, no ground, no shadow plate.
Constraints: one complete sprite only, no typography, no UI, no framing, no other characters, no floating phones or orbiting paper, NO aura, NO magic circles, NO loose particles, NO stars, NO bullets, NO baked attack effects. All visible magical ornaments are attached to her outfit. Keep silhouette coherent and readable at 90px tall. Do not remove or disconnect limbs. Phone screen visible only on its front face.
